recommendations.description: Run an OH claim-classification audit on Not Mapped outpatient claims for DSNP HMO and Medicare HMO, restricting review to National T Codes, Transportation Services Including Ambulance, Chemotherapy Drugs, diagnoses Z5112 and R0602, and provider outliers MIDWEST MEDICAL TRANSPORT COMPANY and KETTERING HEALTH DAYTON before any contract, site-of-care, or management-design changes.
evidence: DSNP HMO Not Mapped claims dominate the OH increase.
National T Codes appear in OP HH/DME with Not Mapped DRG.
MIDWEST MEDICAL TRANSPORT COMPANY concentrates unmapped transportation claims.
Chemotherapy Drugs with Z5112 appear in OP Mgmt Oth Misc.
KETTERING HEALTH DAYTON appears in Not Mapped chemotherapy claims.

recommendations.description: Remap UNATTRIBUTED OP HH/DME claims billed under Not Mapped with National T Codes for diagnoses R6889 and I10 to the correct accountable segment, then review concentrated suppliers/providers and validate authorization, coverage, and benefit-limit edits for those services.
evidence: UNATTRIBUTED OP HH/DME is classified as Not Mapped.
National T Codes drive both leading claim clusters.
R6889 added about $12.4M under the unmapped setup.
I10 added about $5.4M under the same setup.
peer_benchmarking: Centene, Cigna, Elevance, Horizon BCBS, Premera, and Regence BCBS show no documented policy mention.

recommendations.description: Perform a TX Medicare Indiv IP Med/Surg configuration audit for DSNP HMO, CSNP HMO, and Medicare HMO claims assigned to facility type "Not Mapped"; correct service-level mapping, validate claims reprocessing to contractual standards, and confirm authorization-edit enforcement and provider/facility setup.
evidence: DSNP HMO Not Mapped added about $9.3M on roughly 22,789 more claims.
CSNP HMO Not Mapped added about $1.8M on roughly 4,034 more claims.
Medicare HMO Not Mapped added about $1.5M on roughly 1,518 more claims.
All contributing groups carry unmapped-or-unknown flags.
peer_benchmarking: United Health follows ICD-10-CM principal diagnosis sequencing with Excludes1 mutual-exclusivity edits.

recommendations.description: Conduct an OH DSNP HMO acute-hospital utilization management audit at METROHEALTH MAIN CAMPUS MEDICAL CENTER, isolating repeat-admission members and highest-growth inpatient service pathways to tighten admission control design.
evidence: OH DSNP HMO acute hospital spend rose on 8,902 more claims.
Average paid per admit declined statewide, indicating utilization rather than price.
METROHEALTH MAIN CAMPUS MEDICAL CENTER added 1,922 claims within the increase.
peer_benchmarking: Elevance Health (internal) reimbursement summary shows no applicable code interactions and no payment limits.

recommendations.description: Initiate a provider-focused TX DSNP HMO acute-hospital IP Med/Surg audit for BEN TAUB HOSPITAL that reviews admission and level-of-care UM KPIs, validates authorization-denial enforcement, and performs itemized-bill payment review for Major Chest Trauma with CC, Lower Extremity and Humerus Procedures Except Hip, Foot, Femur with MCC, Pulmonary Embolism without MCC, and Inflammatory Bowel Disease with CC.
evidence: TX DSNP HMO acute hospital claims increased by 1,129.
Average paid per admit increased about $893 statewide.
BEN TAUB HOSPITAL appears in multiple outlier source cards.
Lower-extremity and humerus procedure with MCC added about $190K on one claim.
Inflammatory bowel disease with CC averaged about $88.1K per admit.
peer_benchmarking: United Health requires correct principal diagnosis sequencing under ICD-10-CM rules, including sepsis and Excludes1 guidance.
United Health may deny entire inpatient claims or affected professional lines for inappropriate diagnoses.

recommendations.description: Run a focused payment-integrity and contract-compliance audit on OH DSNP HMO IP Med/Surg acute hospital claims for MIAMI VALLEY HOSPITAL, KETTERING HEALTH DAYTON, and GOOD SAMARITAN HOSPITAL, covering claims processing/reprocessing, reimbursement methodology, and manual adjudication overrides; if compliant, initiate provider-specific referral and site-of-care review for Lower Extremity and Humerus Procedures Except Hip, Foot, Femur with MCC.
evidence: Increase concentrated at MIAMI VALLEY HOSPITAL, KETTERING HEALTH DAYTON, GOOD SAMARITAN HOSPITAL.
Claims up and paid per admit up across the same providers.
Validation needed before contract action because claim runs are relatively small.
Key driver includes Lower Extremity and Humerus Procedures Except Hip, Foot, Femur with MCC.
peer_benchmarking: Supplied reimbursement summary shows no documented acute hospital policy scope or appeals detail for Elevance Health or Humana.

recommendations.description: Launch a BEN TAUB HOSPITAL TX DSNP HMO case-review policy for IP Med/Surg admissions with diagnoses T84622A, K5000, I2699, or S2242XA and procedure values Null or Blank/-3, requiring member-level clinical, coding, and utilization management review.
evidence: BEN TAUB HOSPITAL is the provider context for all highlighted admissions.
T84622A lower-extremity surgery added about $190K on one claim.
K5000 inflammatory bowel disease added about $168.7K on one claim.
S2242XA and I2699 showed more claims and higher paid per admit.
Multiple source cards list procedure_name as Null or Blank or -3.
peer_benchmarking: Elevance internal requires POA reporting; HAC/HCAC/PPC inpatient claims may face reduced reimbursement.
Elevance external denies facility claims for documented wrong-surgery never events.

recommendations.description: Initiate a CA acute-hospital IP Med/Surg utilization management policy review for DSNP HMO and Medicare HMO focused on GOOD SAMARITAN HOSPITAL and the DRGs Major Chest Trauma with CC and Lower Extremity and Humerus Procedures Except Hip, Foot, Femur with MCC, including initial and concurrent review KPI assessment and diagnosis-specific preventive management actions.
evidence: GOOD SAMARITAN HOSPITAL accounts for most DSNP HMO increase in CA.
Average paid per admit fell in the main DSNP HMO acute signal.
Major Chest Trauma with CC contributed to CA DSNP acute growth.
Lower Extremity and Humerus Procedures Except Hip, Foot, Femur with MCC drove Medicare HMO growth.
